items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: You know Frank Sinatra songbook you know. And I learned to fake as well.

ctx.x: Why would a young musician not find knowing tunes worthwhile?

Well that’s a good question. I did learn them. I mean I did gigs where you had to. It was dance – a lot of times dance music and you’d have to play medleys of tunes. You know Frank Sinatra songbook you know. And I learned to fake as well. So I got away with murder in a lot of ways you know, because I faked. But I mean all the older musicians as I’d say, they all knew those tunes. I mean you had to know those tunes. And I think the younger guys, it’s what they’re listening to. You know they’re listening to Trane,…
Okay you have to explain that.
